extraction_notes: This is a family datasheet; the BZT52B5V1 row was selected from the BZT52B2V4 through BZT52B51 electrical-characteristics table.

The Fig. 1 zener characteristic points are manually digitized readings from the plotted BZT52B5V1 5.1 V trace; the source IZ axis in mA was converted to A and no intermediate points were interpolated.

The BZT52B5V1 electrical-characteristics row gives VZ = 5.00 V minimum, 5.10 V nominal, and 5.20 V maximum at IZT = 5 mA; maximum ZZT is 60 ohm at IZT, maximum ZZK is 480 ohm at IZK = 1 mA, and admissible IZM is 5 mA.
The electrical-characteristics table gives maximum reverse leakage IR = 2 microA at VR = 2.0 V and typical temperature coefficient limits of -2.7 to 1.2 mV/degC at IZTC.

The supplied datasheet publishes typical family curves for temperature coefficient, leakage current, capacitance, dynamic impedance, and power derating, but does not publish a single capacitance value or reverse-recovery time for BZT52B5V1; specs.capacitance and specs.reverse_recovery are null.
The plotted zener characteristic is a typical pulsed family curve and should not be treated as a guaranteed limit for the individual BZT52B5V1 part.
